newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales for the current marketing year were 38,000 metric tons (MT). Small increases were reported for Canada (22,500 MT--late reporting of white wheat), Nigeria (6,200 MT), South Korea(4,500 MT), and the Netherlands (4,300 MT).

Sales for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year (which begins June 1) totaled 385,600 MT, with unknown destinations (80,200 MT), South Korea (62,500 MT), Turkey (29,000 MT), Honduras (25,500 MT), Mexico (25,500 MT), and Yemen (25,000 MT) being themajor buyers.

Exports of 328,600 MT were three-quarters above the week earlier and one-tenth above the 4-week average. The primary recipients were Japan (103,000 MT), Pakistan (66,600 MT), South Korea (49,000 MT), Nigeria (27,600 MT), and Canada (22,500 MT).
